subject: SCIM delta + least-privilege justification — evidence packet request
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@greengrid.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence needed: SCIM delta extract + min-priv justification

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The SIG assessment team asked for a concise evidence packet to validate identity and access controls before next week's review. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday: 

- SCIM delta export covering 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31 (CSV or ZIP of JSONs)
- Sample SAML assertions for 3 user flows (login, role-assertion, service-account)
- A current RBAC role matrix showing role-to-permission mapping and owners
- A short justification log (one-paragraph per elevated role or service account) that explains why each account is beyond default privileges

If you have a preferred secure link or an audit portal record we can pull from, share that and we can reference it in the SIG report. Also include any known probables (e.g., recently elevated accounts under review).

Emily Park
Security Assurance Manager
GreenGrid Technologies

P.S. audit-portal@vendor-audit.com will be pulling artifacts; they asked to be cc'd on delivery links.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@greengrid.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed: SCIM delta extract + min-priv justification

On Fri, Sep 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM Emily Park <emily.park@greengrid.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday...

Team — Emily from GreenGrid needs a compact evidence packet for SIG. I think we can meet the ask but want to be explicit about owners and redaction. Proposed split of work: 

- Naomi: generate SCIM delta export for Aug 2026 and scrub PII (email hashes only), deliver as ZIP.
- Rishi: pull RBAC role matrix (source: authz-service / roles-db) and map owners; flag any roles without owners.
- Hannah: collect SAML assertion samples (sanitized) and draft 1-paragraph justification for each elevated/service account.

Target timeline: internal draft by 3:00 PM PST today, final secure upload by 5:00 PM. Emily, is a Drive link OK or do you want the vendor portal record number?

I will package and sign the delivery note. Attachments will be labeled with a checksum and a short manifest.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Security & GRC Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed: SCIM delta extract + min-priv justification

Aditya / team — FYI status and source notes: 

- SCIM extract: ran delta export job for 2026-08-01 -> 2026-08-31 from our SCIM-sync service (job id: scim-delta-202608). Output archived to s3://redwood-sec/GreenGrid/202608-scim-delta.zip. I redacted email addresses to hashed form and removed MFA seeds per our PII policy. Zip includes a manifest.json (checksum + record counts).

- RBAC matrix: exporting from authz-db v2.1; I will include a snapshot CSV (rbac_role_matrix_20260829.csv) with columns: role_id, role_name, permissions, owner, last_reviewed. Marked three roles with missing owners.

- SAML samples: Hannah and I coordinated—samples in saml_assertion_samples.txt (assertion IDs replaced, timestamps preserved).

I will upload artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and also register a vendor-portal record (GRN-8342) so the auditor can pull directly. ETA: upload complete by 15:15 PST.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@greengrid.com>, audit-portal@vendor-audit.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery: SCIM delta + RBAC matrix + SAML samples (GreenGrid SIG package)

Emily / Audit team — per our earlier thread, we uploaded the requested artifacts and owner justifications. Delivery summary: 

Attachments (also in Drive / portal):
- redwood_scim_delta_202608.zip (SCIM delta export, records hashed; manifest included)
- rbac_role_matrix_20260829.csv (role -> permission mapping, owner column present)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (sanitized assertion examples)
- justification_log_202608.txt (one-paragraph explanations for elevated/service accounts)

Links / portal record: 
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/GreenGrid/SCIM-delta-20260829
- Vendor portal record: https://vendor-audit.com/portal/records/GRN-8342

Notes and redactions: 
- We hashed user emails in the SCIM export (sha256) and removed MFA seeds per contract. 
- The RBAC snapshot flags 3 roles without an assigned owner; these are noted in the CSV and in the justification log for follow-up.
- SAML samples are sanitized to remove full assertion IDs and nonessential attributes; timestamps preserved for traceability.

If you prefer the artifacts delivered through a signed transfer (DocuSign transfer record) let me know and we can swap the link. Otherwise the Drive link + portal record should be sufficient for the SIG reviewers.

Attached: redwood_scim_delta_202608.zip; rbac_role_matrix_20260829.csv; saml_assertion_samples.txt; justification_log_202608.txt

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Security & GRC Lead
Redwood Inference
